name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a U.S.-based junior gold and silver exploration company focused on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project located in Nevada's Walker Lane mineral belt. The company is in the exploration stage, reporting 2025 reverse circulation drill results including 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres, and commenced a new RC drill program at Lapon Canyon in mid-2026. It also pursues mineral royalty and precious metals streaming opportunities.
